company.shortDescription: Stardrift AI develops custom AI applications, agents, automations, and analytics tools for businesses.
company.description: Stardrift AI develops custom AI applications, autonomous agents, workflow automations, and analytics tools for businesses. Its services include SaaS development, chatbot creation, software engineering, data integration, and enterprise AI implementation. The company also provides AgentNovo, a platform for creating assistants connected to organizational documents, databases, and external tools. Its named agents support research, internal knowledge access, email processing, task planning, voice-to-content generation, customer service, refund handling, and social media publishing.
